caseName: Rodolfo Pada - SF Building Inspector Bribery Syndicate

character.name: Rodolfo Pada
character.title: Building Inspector, San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
character.background: Long-serving building inspector with 14+ years exploiting position
character.motivations: Systematic bribery for financial gain while corrupting building permit process

offense.description: Accepted over $40,000 in bribes from construction firms over 14 years (2003-2017) to approve permits, expedite inspections, and approve building plans - directly compromising building code enforcement and public safety
offense.impact: Compromised building safety standards and permit integrity in San Francisco

howTheyGotAwayWithIt.strategy: Long Career Used to Mitigate Sentencing
keyFactors: Used long government service record as mitigation argument
Bribes characterized as modest compared to scale of corruption
Career-ending rather than jail-ending consequence emphasis
Sentencing judge cited distinguished history as mitigating factor

consequences: Loss of career with public pension implications
Buildings approved without proper safety compliance
Public trust erosion in building safety oversight
Questions about which buildings were approved fraudulently
fallout.avoided: Lengthy prison sentence despite 14 years of systematic bribery

narrative_hooks.headline: SF Building Inspector Took Bribes for 14 Years, Served Only 1 Year in Prison
narrative_hooks.question: How does a decade-plus bribery scheme result in just 13 months of incarceration?
narrative_hooks.investigation_angle: Which San Francisco buildings had their permits fraudulently approved by this inspector?
